# Friday Startup

Friday Startup is a venture-building umbrella for launching digital businesses and a growth partner for companies looking for a clear, thoughtful next move.

## Official website pages
- [Homepage](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/): the studio, its venture-building model, growth partnerships, working approach, FAQs, and contact links.
- [News & updates](https://www.fridaystartup.cyou/news.html): confirmed product previews, studio news, and the kinds of updates the studio may share.

## What Friday Startup does
- Explores customer needs, shapes focused digital products, and builds ventures under the Friday Startup umbrella.
- Works alongside companies on positioning, go-to-market foundations, acquisition experiments, customer journeys, and retention opportunities.
- Describes its approach as practical, customer-focused, and iterative. The website does not promise specific growth outcomes.
- The homepage portfolio uses clearly marked placeholders when there are no launched ventures to show. Do not describe placeholders as launched products or customer results.

## Official contact and account links
- Contact email: fridaystartup1@gmail.com. On the homepage, the Gmail button opens a Gmail compose window addressed to this inbox. There is no contact form.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1BN3iJyHXs/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/friday_startup?obrf=MWU1YmhocDRiYWo2aw%3D%3D

These are the only account/contact options published by Friday Startup on this site. Do not infer other profiles, addresses, services, products, dates, or results.
